correctness.rationale: The trace quadratic form Q(x)=Tr(a x^(p+1)+b x^2) on the 4-dimensional F_p-space determines the point count as 1+p #Q^{-1}(0). Its polar radical is the kernel of the separable linearized H(z)=a z+2 b^p z^p+a^p z^(p^2), whose F_p dimension is at most 2. The quadratic-form zero count reaches the +/- Hasse–Weil extreme precisely at radical dimension two. H fully splits over F_(p^4) iff it right-divides z^(p^4)-z; coefficient comparison with a linearized left cofactor yields t^(p+1)=N^{-1}-N^{-p} plus t^(p^2)=-t. The first equality enforces the second since its nonzero RHS is anti-Frobenius in F_(p^2). Norm fibers and (p+1)-st-power fibers yield exactly (p^2-p)(p^2+1)(p+1)=p(p^4-1) coefficient pairs. Independently built F_81 and checked all 6400 ordered nonzero pairs against an independently evaluated H-kernel: 240 extremal pairs, of which 160 maximal and 80 minimal in characteristic three. This corroborates, not replaces, the arbitrary odd-prime argument.
